entries.proposition: Total vector genomes were fixed per injection and not scaled to age or body weight, so dose per body weight was higher in the youngest animals.
entries.snippet: Doses were not adjusted to age or body weight

entries.proposition: Younger animals received the larger dose per body weight; the authors state it.
entries.snippet: Younger mice, at P1 and P5 treatment, received a higher vector dose per body weight compared to older mice because the doses were fixed and not adjusted for weight or tissue size.

entries.proposition: Day-1 lumbar intrathecal injection of the GFP vector at the lower dose: 47 percent mortality, mean age at termination 10 days.
entries.snippet: AAV9/GFP injected via the IT route caused a 47% mortality rate with an average age at termination of 10 days.

entries.proposition: Day-1 combined intrathecal plus intracerebroventricular injection: 39 percent mortality, mean age at termination 18 days.
entries.snippet: The IT & ICV route caused a 39% mortality rate with an average age at termination of 18 days.

entries.proposition: At day 1, no deaths after intracerebroventricular or intravenous vector and none after vehicle by any route.
entries.snippet: No deaths were recorded from ICV or IV administration of AAV9/GFP, nor were any deaths recorded from a vehicle injection administered by either of the four administration routes.

entries.proposition: Day-5 lumbar intrathecal injection: mortality 70 percent at the higher dose and 17 percent at the lower dose.
entries.snippet: IT administration of AAV9/GFP at 5 × 1011 vg caused a 70% mortality rate and at 2.5 × 1011 vg caused a 17% mortality rate

entries.proposition: At day 5 no deaths after intravenous vector at either dose.
entries.snippet: No deaths were recorded from IV administration of AAV9/GFP at either dose.

entries.proposition: Survival did not differ among groups injected at day 10 or day 28, and weights did not differ.
entries.snippet: No significant differences in survival among P10 or P28 injection treatment groups were observed. Additionally, no significant differences in weight were observed for any group.

entries.proposition: Every euthanised animal reviewed had spinal cord abnormality and none had abnormality in the dorsal root ganglion.
entries.snippet: All terminated mice reviewed displayed some degree of abnormality in the spinal cord, but notably no abnormality in the dorsal root ganglion.

entries.proposition: Table A2: in a euthanised animal with diffuse cervical spinal cord degeneration the dorsal root ganglion is reported normal.
entries.snippet: Dorsal Root Ganglion Normal Cervical Spinal Cord Diffuse degeneration-vacuolation of the dorsal tracts
entries.anchor: Table A2, first animal with cervical findings

entries.proposition: The authors attribute the deaths to localised GFP over-expression, state that GFP can be toxic and potentially immunogenic, and did not test it with a null or promoterless control.
entries.snippet: The deaths observed in mice dosed P1 and P5 was most likely due to localized GFP overexpression toxicity.

entries.proposition: The attribution is an inference from timing (peak of self-complementary expression) and from other transgenes at similar doses being tolerated in other studies.
entries.snippet: Similar doses of other transgenes delivered with AAV9 have been well tolerated in other studies at these young ages

entries.proposition: The dorsal root ganglion is transduced by every route and age on GFP immunohistochemistry; the authors say it is unclear whether route or age changes its amount.
entries.snippet: it remains unclear if route of administration or treatment age effects the amount of transgene expression in this region.

entries.proposition: The authors say mice may be less prone to dorsal root ganglion toxicity than rats or primates.
entries.snippet: it has been shown that mice may be less prone to this specific toxicity than rats or non-human primates

entries.proposition: Direct cerebrospinal fluid routes transduce peripheral tissue to a similar extent as the intravenous route.
entries.snippet: IT, ICV, and IT & ICV routes of administration transduce peripheral tissue to a similar extent as IV administration.

entries.proposition: Liver transduction rose with age at injection, highest at day 28, more than it varied with route.
entries.snippet: Liver transduction was most affected by age rather than route of administration, where P28-treated animals showed the highest GFP expression levels

entries.proposition: Brain and spinal cord expression appeared higher after injection at younger ages regardless of route.
entries.snippet: regardless of route of administration, GFP expression in younger mice appeared to be higher than in older mice.

entries.proposition: The authors say no significant dose effect was detected and that the study may be underpowered rather than saturated.
entries.snippet: No significant dose effects on biodistribution were detected, which might be a reflection of the study being underpowered to see these differences rather than a saturation effect at the lower dose.

entries.proposition: The authors give a mouse-to-human dose approximation for the lower dose, citing another source.
entries.snippet: a 2.5 × 1011 vg mouse dose approximates to a 1.00 × 1015 vg human dose

entries.proposition: Authors' advice: day-1 injection overestimates the transduction a postnatal human would reach and so underestimates a minimally effective dose.
entries.snippet: since it overestimates the transduction efficiency that could be expected in a postnatal human, and thus underestimates a minimally effective dose.

entries.proposition: Table 1 footnote: the day-5 higher-dose lumbar intrathecal group was not fully enrolled because of mortality.
entries.snippet: Not fully enrolled due to a high mortality rate.
